description: Na₂CdSnS₄ is Stannite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four S atoms to form NaS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent CdS₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four equivalent SnS₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.74 Å) and two longer (2.77 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four S atoms to form NaS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent CdS₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four equivalent SnS₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.84 Å) and two longer (2.89 Å) Na-S bond lengths. Cd is bonded to four S atoms to form CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SnS₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaS₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.56 Å) and two longer (2.57 Å) Cd-S bond lengths. Sn is bonded to four S atoms to form SnS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CdS₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaS₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.42 Å) and two longer (2.43 Å) Sn-S bond lengths. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to two Na, one Cd, and one Sn atom to form corner-sharing SNa₂CdSn tetrahedra. In the second S site, S is bonded to two Na, one Cd, and one Sn atom to form corner-sharing SNa₂CdSn tetrahedra.
